description: Modern Persian Date Picker control for Avalonia UI with Jalali/Shamsi calendar support. Features include RTL/LTR layouts, keyboard navigation, editable mode, month/year selection, and full Persian calendar calculations.
releaseNotes: 2.6.12 - New ShowClearButton: an x inside the field (and Ctrl+Delete) clears it while it holds a date, a range or typed text. Redesigned Quick Range panel: eight presets with their length (new: Yesterday, Last 7 days, Last month, Last 30 days), a Month / Season / Half-year grid with a year stepper, From / To, a summary and Clear / Cancel / Apply. Behaviour change: a preset or period fills From / To and Apply commits it (it used to apply at once). New ICalendarLocalization members with English defaults (existing implementations still compile); English half-year names are now First Half / Second Half. Custom QuickRangeView templates must use the new template parts. 2.5.12 - New calendar-neutral RangeStartDateTime / RangeEndDateTime (DateTime?, two-way), kept in sync with RangeStart / RangeEnd both ways and unchanged by a calendar, culture or language switch (RangeStart / RangeEnd are converted). Range mode parses typed text as a range (start ~ end, plus times when IsTimePickerEnabled) instead of writing a single SelectedDate; an invalid range follows InvalidValueAction and is reported through HasInvalidInput under Keep. Clear() also empties the range. 2.4.12 - An editable picker shows the application's Watermark (it always showed the localized "select a date" label; left at its default the label is still used). Clear() also empties the text box and resets HasInvalidInput when the date was already empty (text that is not a date typed into an empty field kept the text and the flag). 2.3.12 was published by mistake from the same code with the old 2.2.12 assembly version - use 2.4.12. 2.2.12 - The time section is always left-to-right (it inherited an RTL container's direction). The controls' looks are ControlThemes keyed by type (app styles override any setter, BasedOn works, subclasses get the look). The text box's padding / vertical alignment are bound to the picker's Padding / VerticalContentAlignment (new). Behaviour changes: no default MinWidth (was 200); focus changes the border colour only (no 2 px border); an editable picker is not focusable itself - FocusEditableText() focuses its text box. Theme="Light" in a Dark application is now light, and the C# copy of the Dark palette is gone. The calendar button has its own theme and a new PersianDatePickerIconForegroundBrush key; the popup is at least as wide as the field; new SelectedDateCalendar. 2.1.12 - Typed dates are never silently replaced: HasInvalidInput reports an invalid entry kept under InvalidValueAction.Keep, CommitText() parses the box on demand, and an empty box means no date under Keep and SetToNull (behaviour change: Keep used to keep the old date). Persian and Arabic-Indic digits are accepted. New calendar-neutral SelectedDateTime (DateTime?, two-way). Auto mode follows a runtime culture switch via the static NotifyCultureChanged() / RefreshCalendar(), and switching CalendarType converts from the calendar the values are actually in. 2.0.0 - Breaking change: replaced Hour/Minute/Second properties on ModernPersianDatePicker (and Hour/Minute/Second on TimePickerView) with a single SelectedTime / Time property of type TimeSpan. Adds range-mode time support via RangeStartTime/RangeEndTime and a Quick Range panel that exposes time spinners on its From/To pickers.
